kibana.alert.attack_discovery.title: Encoded PowerShell download cradle with C2 and lateral movement
kibana.alert.attack_discovery.summary_ma: Office spawned hidden encoded PowerShell, which reached a malicious C2 domain, wrote a Run key, and copied a payload to an administrative SMB share.
kibana.alert.attack_discovery.details_ma: On {{ host.name wks-alice-01 }}, {{ user.name alice.chen }} opened Word, which spawned powershell.exe with -EncodedCommand. The same PowerShell process connected to malicious-c2.example.com, created HKCU Run persistence for update.ps1, then copied payload.exe to \\srv-files-02\ADMIN$. This is a multi-stage intrusion spanning execution, command-and-control, persistence, and lateral movement.
